faqs.question: What is the duration of the Yaksha research internship?
faqs.answer: The internship runs for exactly two months full-time, during which interns work on open-source research and engineering problems at Vicharanashala Lab, IIT Ropar.

faqs.question: Is a monthly stipend provided to research interns?
faqs.answer: Yes, all approved full-time interns receive a stipend to cover basic expenses during their research period at the institute.

faqs.question: Do I get an official certificate after completing the internship?
faqs.answer: Yes, successful candidates who complete their final presentations and get approval from their mentors receive an internship completion certificate from IIT Ropar.

faqs.question: Which Node.js version is recommended for development?
faqs.answer: We recommend using Node.js v18 or v20 LTS. Be sure to check package.json for engines restrictions and lockfiles to prevent runtime inconsistencies.

faqs.question: Why does pnpm fail to install with workspace prefix errors?
faqs.answer: This happens when running standard npm or older pnpm versions. Always use npx pnpm or pnpm v9+ to correctly resolve linked workspace packages.

faqs.question: How do we initialize local environment variables?
faqs.answer: Copy the .env.example file to .env inside the apps/backend directory and configure your MONGODB_URI and JWT_SECRET keys.

faqs.question: Are we required to work on-campus at IIT Ropar?
faqs.answer: Yes, the internship is a full-time residential program. Interns are expected to work from the Vicharanashala Lab on campus.

faqs.question: How do I get an access card for the research lab?
faqs.answer: You can request lab access cards from the department office by submitting your selection letter and student ID.

faqs.question: Are hostel accommodations provided for outstation interns?
faqs.answer: Hostel rooms are subject to availability. Interns can apply for shared hostel accommodation at student rates through the admin office.

faqs.question: What are the criteria for the final internship evaluation?
faqs.answer: Evaluation is based on your open-source contributions, pull request quality, code reviews, and a final technical presentation before the lab committee.

faqs.question: How often should I sync with my project mentor?
faqs.answer: We suggest having brief daily standups or check-ins on Slack, and a more thorough review session once a week to demo progress.

faqs.question: Where should I submit my pull requests for review?
faqs.answer: All pull requests should be submitted to the development branch of the respective Github repository, tagging your mentor as the reviewer.
